threshold_rationale.selected_measure: VA compensation and pension rating bundle claims backlog
threshold_rationale.why_this_measure: The claims backlog is a direct claims-timeliness pressure signal already attached in the Veterans depth card from the VA Detailed Claims Data dashboard. It is usable as a narrow no-regression baseline for the claims-timeliness floor, but backlog alone is not a service-package model, not a full timeliness distribution, and not an efficiency or savings finding.
threshold_rationale.threshold_rule: A lower-cost veterans scenario cannot pass the claims-timeliness floor if reviewed policy and stress evidence show the compensation and pension rating bundle claims backlog rising above the 2026-06-30 VA probe baseline.

primary_baseline.measure: Compensation and pension rating bundle claims backlog

baseline_values.boundary: The backlog and quality probes are review signals only. They are not a complete claims-timeliness series, not appeals evidence, not per-veteran cost evidence, not a service-package path, not a waste finding, not a fraud finding, and not savings evidence.

remaining_requirements: complete claims timeliness series and metric definition review
claims accuracy, appeals, and remediation evidence
pass/fail evidence comparing policy and stress values with the threshold
public_warning: This packet selects a draft no-regression claims-backlog floor threshold and baseline value for the Veterans lane only. It is not role-reviewed final threshold selection, not a complete claims-timeliness series, not appeals evidence, not policy values, not stress values, not pass/fail evidence, not lower-cost scenario admissibility, not target-cost selection, not gross savings, not net savings, not solver input, not rate calculation, not a public rate card, not a department-cut instruction, not a technology-savings claim, and not a balanced-budget claim.
